title: Hope allows an ending another view

captions.physics: Ending an earlier way of participating

meaning: Ending earlier participation through openness to possibility can emotionally become a suspension of a previous judgement about events.
text: A completed phase does not always receive a familiar emotional assessment immediately. Death in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions that end an earlier form. The Star in energy gives a motive to remain open to possibility, share attention and sustain hope. The Hanged Man in emotions adds the experience of a suspended perspective: an apparently obvious outcome temporarily looks different. You may concretely finish participation without closing the prospect and feel the unfamiliarity of seeing your shared experience another way.

For example, you finish a creative course together and collect the final pieces. Hope of continuing in your own way helps you avoid clinging to the former timetable. At home, you look at unfinished trials and unexpectedly stop seeing them only as failures. **The phase has ended, while our view of the remaining work is still changing.** Emotional suspension concerns an assessment of experience; it requires neither calling every object valuable immediately nor finding a new meaning for it.

A difficulty arises if another perspective is declared the required reward for hope. One person must then recognise inspiration in something still experienced as loss or failure. The Hanged Man promises no identical assessment, and the Star requires no confident optimism. Death concerns a particular form ending rather than every doubt finishing alongside it. The last practical actions may already be complete while the emotional perspective remains open for both people to explore differently.
